result:
Fixed in `anthrouter/pace.py`. `period_workday_dates` treated `period_end` (the exclusive start of next month) as inclusive. In UTC that counted Oct 1, a Thursday, as a September workday, giving 23 instead of 22. It now uses the local date of the last instant before `period_end`.

The 53 pace/workday tests pass. I didn't wait for the full suite, which was still running in the background when I stopped.
